provenance.description: Genuine finalized Hoodi committee transitions 492 → 493 → 494. Original bootstrap and signed updates are unchanged. The two acquisition records below retain their original ranges; combined ancestry has 10,614 headers. BLS acceptance is checked by the owning-program replay test, not asserted by acquisition.

period492To493.description: Genuine Hoodi Fulu light-client updates and complete canonical parent-header ancestry for period 492 to 493. Update494 is retained acquisition material, not an ancestry-qualification claim.

acquisition.fetchTier: Direct HTTPS Beacon REST JSON with Accept: application/json; no scrape/proxy transformation

networkLimits.alternative: Two paced workers, one-second pause between slots, ten-second delay only if still unsuccessful, at most three recovery attempts

limitations: 2068 HTTP 429 rate-limit responses were observed and retained verbatim in attempts; 37 initially unresolved slots were fully acquired by a slower two-worker recovery. No unresolved slots remain.
404 slots are recorded as skipped only because the verified adjacent actual headers form one unbroken parent-root chain across them.

Header roots and full ancestry were computed independently of repository decoder and provider-reported root values. Existing update BLS signatures and block proposer signatures are preserved, not newly signature-verified here; the genuine owner test remains Main-owned.
Single already-recorded public Beacon provider; root-ID requests cross-check trusted signed-update endpoint identities on that same provider. No public-lane or production qualification claim.

validation.implementation: Node.js stdlib crypto SHA-256; SSZ BeaconBlockHeader five-field container: slot/proposer_index uint64 little endian padded to 32 bytes, three bytes32 roots, three zero chunks, three binary SHA-256 Merkle levels
